description: Claude Code plugin that orchestrates AI agents across multiple projects using Agent Teams, co-founder personas, VP project managers, and Ralph Loop execution

userStories.title: Create plugin scaffold and directory structure
userStories.description: As the user, I need the base plugin directory structure so all other skills and state have a home.
acceptanceCriteria: Create plugin directory at ~/.claude/plugins/two-slice-team/
Create plugin.json with name 'two-slice-team', description, and skill declarations for: cofounder, standup, project-create, project-list, project-meeting, project-work
Create state/ directory with an empty projects.json: { "projects": [] }
Create empty directories: discussions/, standups/, meetings/
Create skills/ directory for SKILL.md files
Create templates/ directory for project template files
plugin.json is valid JSON and follows Claude Code plugin spec
userStories.notes: Plugin scaffold created at plugin/ with symlink to ~/.claude/plugins/two-slice-team/

userStories.title: Create project template files
userStories.description: As the user, I need standardized template files that get copied into every new project so VPs and Ralph can operate autonomously.
acceptanceCriteria: Create templates/CLAUDE.md.template with: Vision placeholder, Work Documentation section (status updates, work logging, inbox checking instructions), Project Conventions placeholder, Allowed Commands placeholder
Create templates/status.md with: Last updated, Current state, Recently Completed, In Progress, Up Next, Blockers sections
Create templates/worklog.md with: header and initial 'Project created' entry placeholder
Create templates/inbox.md with: instructions for marking items [SEEN] and '(no items yet)' placeholder
Create templates/roadmap.md with: Vision, Milestones, and Current Focus section placeholders
Create templates/next-tasks.md with: Prioritized Tasks section and empty list placeholder
All template files use consistent markdown formatting
userStories.notes: Templates created: CLAUDE.md.template, status.md, worklog.md, inbox.md, roadmap.md, next-tasks.md

userStories.title: Create /project create skill
userStories.description: As the user, I want a /project create slash command that bootstraps a new project directory with the full template and registers it in projects.json.
acceptanceCriteria: Create skills/project-create/SKILL.md with trigger on '/project create'
Skill accepts project name as required argument and optional --path flag for custom directory

Skill instructions tell the agent to: create project directory (default ~/Documents/<name>), copy all templates from templates/ into the project's docs/ dir, generate CLAUDE.md from template with project name and vision, create .claude/settings.json with empty allowedCommands, create scripts/ralph/ directory, create empty prd.json and progress.txt

Skill instructions tell the agent to: add project entry to state/projects.json with id (kebab-case), name, path, status 'active', vp_name (auto-generated), created_at (ISO date), vision (empty string)
Skill instructions include the full CLAUDE.md template content inline so agent can generate it
SKILL.md includes example usage: /project create my-cool-app --path /Users/me/projects/my-cool-app
userStories.notes: Self-contained SKILL.md with all template content inline, VP name generation, and projects.json registration

userStories.title: Create /project list and management skill
userStories.description: As the user, I want slash commands to list projects, view status, and pause/resume projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Create skills/project-list/SKILL.md with triggers on '/project list', '/project status', '/project pause', '/project resume'
'/project list' reads state/projects.json and displays: name, status (active/inactive), VP name, path, vision summary for each project
'/project status <project-id>' reads the project's docs/status.md from the path in projects.json and displays it
'/project pause <project-id>' sets status to 'inactive' in state/projects.json
'/project resume <project-id>' sets status to 'active' in state/projects.json
Skill handles case where project-id is not found with clear error message
userStories.notes: Handles list, status, pause, resume with error handling for not-found projects

userStories.title: Create /cofounder skill with both personas
userStories.description: As the user, I want a /cofounder slash command that spawns co-founder agent team teammates for ideation and research.
acceptanceCriteria: Create skills/cofounder/SKILL.md with triggers on '/cofounder', '/cofounder discuss', '/cofounder research', '/cofounder both'

Skill instructs the lead to spawn Co-Founder 1 (Discussion Partner) as an agent team teammate with spawn prompt: Socratic questioning persona, devil's advocate, structured decision-making, summarize conclusions, ask probing questions

Skill instructs the lead to spawn Co-Founder 2 (Research/Serendipity) as a teammate with spawn prompt: web research directive, instruction to read files from ~/.claude/plugins/two-slice-team/discussions/ for past context, lateral thinking, surface unexpected connections
'/cofounder discuss' spawns only Co-Founder 1, '/cofounder research' spawns only Co-Founder 2, '/cofounder both' spawns both

Skill includes instruction to save discussion summary at session end to discussions/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md with YAML frontmatter (date, participants, topics, related_projects) and body (key points, decisions, action items tagged with project IDs, open questions)
Skill includes instruction to route action items tagged with project IDs to those projects' docs/inbox.md files
userStories.notes: Both personas with spawn prompts, discussion saving with YAML frontmatter, and inbox routing for action items

userStories.title: Create /standup skill for VP standup meetings
userStories.description: As the user, I want a /standup slash command that spawns one VP teammate per active project to report status in parallel.
acceptanceCriteria: Create skills/standup/SKILL.md with trigger on '/standup'
Skill instructs the lead to: read state/projects.json, filter to active projects, spawn one agent team teammate per active project

Each VP teammate spawn prompt includes: VP persona for that project, instruction to cd into the project's path, read docs/status.md and docs/worklog.md and docs/inbox.md, then message the lead with a standup report (done since last standup, planned next, blockers)
Skill instructs the lead to synthesize all VP reports into a summary and present to the user
Skill instructs the lead to save standup summary to standups/YYYY-MM-DD.md
Skill notes that VPs should update docs/status.md with any new direction received from the user during standup
userStories.notes: Spawns one VP per active project, synthesizes reports, saves to standups/YYYY-MM-DD.md

userStories.title: Create /project meeting skill for deep VP planning
userStories.description: As the user, I want a /project meeting slash command that spawns a VP for a specific project to do deep planning and roadmap clarification.
acceptanceCriteria: Create skills/project-meeting/SKILL.md with trigger on '/project meeting <project-id>'
Skill looks up project in state/projects.json to get path and metadata

Skill instructs the lead to spawn one VP teammate with spawn prompt that includes: full project context instruction (read CLAUDE.md, docs/status.md, docs/worklog.md, docs/roadmap.md), instruction to also read relevant discussion files from discussions/ that mention this project
VP teammate covers: vision clarification, roadmap priorities, process agreements, documentation standards
VP generates or updates docs/roadmap.md with milestones and priorities
VP generates initial prd.json with user stories if the project is new and has no prd.json
Skill instructs the lead to save meeting notes to meetings/YYYY-MM-DD-<project-id>.md
userStories.notes: VP planning with vision, roadmap, PRD generation, discussion context, and meeting notes

userStories.title: Create /project work skill for Ralph Loop kickoff
userStories.description: As the user, I want a /project work slash command that prepares and kicks off a Ralph Loop for autonomous execution on a project.
acceptanceCriteria: Create skills/project-work/SKILL.md with trigger on '/project work <project-id>'
Skill looks up project in state/projects.json to get path

Skill instructs the agent to: verify prd.json exists in project root with at least one story where passes is false, verify progress.txt exists, verify scripts/ralph/ralph.sh exists (if not, copy from ralph plugin or create it)
Skill instructs the agent to: log work session start in docs/worklog.md with date and description of what Ralph will work on
Skill instructs the agent to: run ralph.sh --tool claude from the project directory to start the Ralph Loop
Skill includes instruction for the agent to update docs/status.md after Ralph completes
Skill handles the case where no incomplete stories exist in prd.json with a message suggesting /project meeting first
userStories.notes: Verifies prerequisites, logs work session, runs ralph.sh --tool claude, updates status after completion
